expertApply.title: Apply to Join Our Expert Pool
expertApply.intro: Fill in the form below to apply as a trainer, coach, or mentor. Our team will review your profile and be in touch.
expertApply.professionalTitleHint: e.g. Business Development Expert, Women's Empowerment Coach
expertApply.countriesHint: Select all countries where you have worked or are based.
expertApply.photoNote: JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 5MB. A professional headshot is preferred.
expertApply.photoConsent: I consent to my photo being used as part of my expert profile on The LEE Experience platform.
expertApply.degreeDetailsHint: For each degree, list: major/field, university name, and year of graduation.
expertApply.degreeDetailsPlaceholder: e.g. MBA in Finance, American University of Beirut, 2015 | BSc in Computer Science, Cairo University, 2010
expertApply.majorFieldOfStudyHint: e.g. Business Administration, Engineering, Public Health
expertApply.certificationsHint: List any relevant professional certifications or training programs you have completed.
expertApply.certificationsPlaceholder: e.g. PMP (Project Management Professional), 2019 | ILO Business Edge Trainer Certification, 2021
expertApply.licensesMembershipsHint: List any professional licenses or memberships (e.g. bar association, engineering syndicate).
expertApply.shortBioHint: Write a brief summary of your background, expertise, and what you bring to the expert pool (3–5 sentences).
expertApply.expertiseKeywordsHint: Choose up to 3 keywords that best describe your expertise (e.g. Green Finance, Women Leadership, Agri-Business).
expertApply.expertiseKeywordsPlaceholder: e.g. Green Finance, Women Leadership, Agri-Business
expertApply.notableWorkHint: Describe a project, publication, or achievement you are particularly proud of.
expertApply.languagesHint: List all languages you can work in and your proficiency level.
expertApply.publishConsentHint: May we publish your profile on our public website and expert directory?
